_notes: M37 spec v1 (2026-04-24): reverse-engineered from
rawdata/M37/mode_{1,2,5,7}/chunk_*.json. Field analysis notes
at slot_designer/tests/fixtures/M37_field_analysis.md.
Machine type — Classic 3-reel 1-payline + Lightning-Link-style
jackpot-tier boosters:
- Classic 1-line chassis (3x3 grid, middle row = sole payline)
- Aristocrat Lightning Link DNA on middle reel: mini/minor/major/
grand booster symbols that multiply 3-match pays by x2/x5/x10/x100
- NO feature engine (no ST=14/15, no bonus chain, no free spins)
- Wild only on reels 1+3; boosters only on reel 2
Pay logic:
A. col_1 is regular/wild + col_0/2 match (wild-subbed) -> pay_id 1-7
(high7 10x / 7bar 6x / 3bar 5x / 2bar 4x / 1bar 3x / mixed-high7-7bar
2x / mixed bars 1x). Wild is multiplier=1.
B. col_1 is booster + col_0/2 form 3-match anchor -> same pay_id as A
but multiplier x booster_mult (mini=2, minor=5, major=10, grand=100).
C. col_1 is booster + col_0/2 BOTH wild -> separate pay_id 102-104
(mini=20x, minor=50x, major=100x; grand variant BLOCKED by re-roll).
D. col_1 is booster + col_0/2 don't form pay -> pay_id 8 (grand 100x)
or pay_id 9 (mini 2x / minor 5x / major 10x).
E. col_0 or col_2 is wild + col_1 blank/non-booster + no 3-match ->
pay_id 9 x 1 (flat, doesn't double for 2 wilds).
Re-roll mechanic:
(wild, grand, wild) on middle row is FORBIDDEN. Observed 0 hits in
2,138,000 rounds of mode 7 rawdata (expected ~3000 by natural rate).
Blocks 'easy' path to the 1000x top tier via pure wild; forces top
to flow through (high7|wild, grand, high7|wild) = pay_id 1 x 100 = 1000x.
Backend server-side re-draws the spin; engine/spin.py mirrors this.
Max payout: 1000x (pay_id 1 x grand center, e.g. high7-grand-high7).

pays._note: (wild, major, wild) = high7 base x major = 100x
grand alone (no side match) has its own pay_id (jackpot UX tier)
wild on col 0 or col 2 (or both), no other match -> flat 1x

reroll_blocks.reason: prevent pure-wild path to 1000x top tier; forces grand-1000 through high7 anchor

extra_round_fields._note: ReelSkin field in each round = current mode number (1/2/5/7); emitter reads mode to populate it.
